highlights: Gemini API 预览 Tool Retrieval：工具参数 schema 按需加载，支持 Gemini 3.6 及之后的模型。
微软发布 Windows 端侧小模型 Aion 1.0 Instruct；OpenAI 公开用 Codex Agent 自动排查性能回归的 Performance Factory。
论文 Resolution Hypothesis 指出，Agent 自我进化的瓶颈在于噪声评估分辨不出更好的候选。

items.title: Gemini API 预览 Tool Retrieval：按需加载工具 schema
items.summary: Google 在 Gemini Interactions API 中预览 Tool Retrieval：请求里加入 tool_search 工具、给工具设置 defer_loading 后，模型只看到工具的名称和描述，需要时再按名字加载参数 schema；对 mcp_server 工具设置 defer_loading，整个远程 MCP 服务器的工具也会按需加载。功能不单独收费，支持 Gemini 3.6 及之后的模型。工具库很大的 Agent 可以借此减少输入 token，而且已加载的 schema 追加在对话后部，提示前缀保持不变，便于缓存。

evidence.quote: To turn on Tool Retrieval, add a tool_search tool to your request and set defer_loading: true on the tools you want to hold back. The model still sees the name and description of every deferred tool, so it knows what's available, but the parameter schemas stay out of context.
Set defer_loading: true on an mcp_server tool and every tool that server exposes is loaded on demand
Tool Retrieval has no separate charge. Input and output tokens are billed at the standard rates for the model you call.
Tool Retrieval works with Gemini 3.6 and later models
the schemas the model loads are added later in the conversation, so the cached prefix stays the same from turn to turn

items.title: 微软发布 Windows 端侧小模型 Aion 1.0 Instruct
items.summary: 微软 Windows Applied Sciences Group 在 Hugging Face 发布 2.3B 参数的 Aion 1.0 Instruct，定位为 Windows 生态的基础小语言模型（SLM），针对端侧 AI、文本和操作系统场景优化，上下文 32,768 tokens，MIT 许可。模型卡称，进一步优化的版本将配合微软的内容审核模型，于 2027 年一月底前成为 Windows 系统的 SLM；目前先发布未量化版本，量化版随后推出。为 Windows 做端侧功能的开发者可以提前用它评估效果。

evidence.quote: Aion Instruct serves as the foundational Small Language Model (SLM) in the Windows ecosystem, specifically optimized for on-device AI, text and operating system use cases. This 2.3B parameters base model
A further optimized version of Aion Instruct, coupled with Microsoft’s content moderation model, will become the Windows OS SLM by the end of January 2027.
We are publishing the unquantized model first, to be followed by quantized versions.
Context length 32,768 tokens
Aion 1.0 Instruct Microsoft Windows Applied Sciences Group
This model is released under the MIT License

items.title: OpenAI 公开 Performance Factory：用 Codex Agent 排查性能回归
items.summary: OpenAI 介绍了内部的 Performance Factory：工程师为重复性工作定义 workflow，性能告警触发后由云端的 Codex Agent 调查回归、找出根因，另一个 Codex 会话做对抗式审查、尝试推翻诊断；通过后由 Codex 实现修复并开 PR，工程师审阅后决定是否合并。人工复核 100 条根因建议，70% 被评为准确。想把编码 Agent 用到线上运维的团队，可以参考它拆分任务、加入对抗式审查和人工把关的做法。

evidence.quote: In the Performance Factory, our engineers define workflows for recurring jobs and write instructions for the Codex agents that carry them out. In particular, the Regression Workflow opens a task when a performance alert fires.
we added an adversarial review: a separate Codex session that tries to disprove the proposed diagnosis.
In a manual review of 100 root cause suggestions, we graded 70% as accurate, with 30% needing further refinement or not fully establishing causality.
Once the diagnosis passes adversarial review, the workflow asks Codex to implement a fix and open a pull request. An engineer reviews the PR and decides whether to merge it.

items.title: Cloudflare 发布 27B 多模态结构化抽取模型 Clairic
items.summary: Clairic 基于 Qwen3.8-27B，输入文本或 JSON 状态（可附图片）和一组字段定义，输出带类型的值、列表、空值、估计值和预测路径，并给出抽取置信度和空值概率，以 Apache-2.0 许可发布。需要从文档或图片中抽取结构化字段的开发者，可以按每个字段的置信度决定哪些结果要人工复核。

evidence.quote: Clairic is a 27B multimodal model that turns a state and a schema of typed fields into structured answers. It supports text and image inputs, extraction, numerical estimation, and forecasting.

Base model: Qwen3.8-27B . Inputs: a text or JSON state, optional images, and a mapping of field names to specifications. Outputs: typed values, lists, nulls, estimates, and forecast paths. Scoring: extraction confidence and null probabilities
Released under the Apache-2.0 license.

items.title: Inworld 开源 48 kHz 人声分离模型 Voice Isolator
items.summary: Inworld Voice Isolator v1 包含离线和实时两个模型，去除人声周围的噪声、只保留前景人声；实时版 58.2M 参数，在 20 ms look-ahead 下算法延迟为 63 ms，可用于通话和直播。模型以 Apache-2.0 许可发布，第一版只做降噪，不修复录音丢失的内容，修复计划在 version 2 推出。做语音 Agent 或音频处理管线的开发者可以把它用作人声前处理。

evidence.quote: Open-license (Apache-2.0) 48 kHz voice isolation for noisy speech recordings and live audio. TL;DR Inworld Voice Isolator v1 ships as two models that share one architecture
The realtime model has 58.2M; its blocks are causal and it carries a look-ahead embedding.
its algorithmic latency is 63 ms at 20 ms of look-ahead. Both keep the foreground voice
version 1 does denoising (noise suppression): it removes what surrounds the voice and restores nothing the recording lost, such as missing bandwidth; restoration comes with version 2.
With the realtime model, use them for live calls and streams.

items.title: Bria 发布 RMBG 3.0：用 8B 生成模型做背景移除
items.summary: RMBG 3.0 是 Bria 第三代背景移除模型，也是第一个基于生成式基础模型的版本：在 Fibo 2.0 上微调并蒸馏，4 步生成 alpha matte。在 Bria 自己对 234 张困难图片的对比中，它平均排名 1.51，相对 RMBG-2.0 的偏好率为 60.9%。权重采用 CC BY-NC 4.0 非商用许可，商用需另签协议或改用 Bria API；处理毛发、运动模糊等难例的开发者可以先用它评估效果。

evidence.quote: RMBG 3.0 is the third generation of Bria's background removal models, and the first one built on a generative foundation. It is Fibo 2.0 , fine-tuned and distilled to do one thing very well: turn any photo into a clean, soft alpha matte in just 4 steps
Foundation: Fibo 2.0 , an 8B-parameter flow-matching DiT
Average rank 1.51 across 234 hard images, best or tied-best on 185 of them (79%).
Preferred 55.1% vs Photoroom, 59.4% vs remove.bg (Canva), 60.9% vs RMBG-2.0
#1 on motion blur, multiple subjects, holes & mesh, shadows & reflections, hair & fur
Weights are released under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International (CC BY-NC 4.0), the same terms as the Fibo 2.0 family.
Commercial use requires a separate agreement with Bria AI. Get a license here , or use the commercially licensed Bria API and fal endpoint

items.title: Resolution Hypothesis：Agent 自我进化卡在分不清哪个更好
items.summary: 上海科技大学的论文提出 Resolution Hypothesis：Agent 进化（提出候选的提示词、skill、记忆并择优保留）停滞，往往不是因为提不出更好的候选，而是噪声评估分辨不出来。在七种进化方法、六个模型、超过 10M 次 LLM 调用的实验中，候选层面的选择不比随机好；方法层面几个百分点的领先，小于同一方法两次独立运行之间的差距。做提示词或 skill 自动优化的团队，在相信小幅提升之前应先确认它超过了运行间的波动。

evidence.quote: #3 Paper of the day · ShanghaiTech University
At the candidate level (choosing artifacts), helpful candidate artifacts exist, but selection is no better than random at telling them from harmful ones, so errors accumulate across rounds.

items.title: AnyS1：用 4B 小模型替大模型做 Agent 流程里的选择
items.summary: AnyS1 从超过 1,000 个公开 skill 中挖掘可枚举的决策点，在隔离容器里收集真实执行状态，训练一个 4B 的 pointer System-1 模型；运行时常规选择一次前向完成，置信度低于校准阈值时再交给大模型（System-2）。在三个未见过的基准上，它保持任务可靠性，同时比未编译的 System-2 Agent 降低 75-91% 的 episode 成本和 63-92% 的模型调用时间。按 skill 组织流程的 Agent 可以借此把大量常规决策下放给小模型。

evidence.quote: AnyS1 mines grounded enumerable decisions across over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers
trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing
cutting episode cost by 75-91% and model-call time by 63-92% relative to an uncompiled System-2 agent

items.title: Jeveration：单次前向生成 512x512 图像只需 78 ms
items.summary: 论文把 System One 式的并行预测用于图像生成：基于冻结的视觉语言模型，一次前向传播生成整张图，并让所有位置共享一个随机状态来协调并行预测、保证整体一致。同一个 checkpoint 支持文生图、图生图和稠密预测，生成 512x512 图像用时 78 ms，比现有统一模型最多快 122x。对需要低延迟出图的应用，这是一条单步生成的思路。

evidence.quote: so that one checkpoint supports all three tasks, each in one forward pass. Experiments show that Jeveration generates a 512x512 image in 78 ms, up to 122x faster than existing unified models, while maintaining competitive image quality and dense prediction performance.

items.title: Game2Player：让 Agent 自己搭游戏环境、收集训练数据
items.summary: Game2Player 由 Builder Agent 改造现有网页游戏、暴露内部状态并定义带进度度量和成功检查的任务，Coding Player 和 VLM Player 尝试完成任务、把问题反馈给 Builder 修复。由此得到 568 个网页游戏、3,436 个任务和 307 小时游戏经验；用这些轨迹训练后，9B 模型在留出的 PlayerBench 游戏上的进度从 14.3% 提升到 31.2%。做视觉 Agent 的团队可以参考这种环境与玩家共同迭代的数据生产方式。

evidence.quote: yielding 568 games, 3,436 tasks, and 307 hours of gameplay. Training on these trajectories raises a 9B model’s progress from 14.3% to 31.2% on held-out PlayerBench games, with gains that transfer to GameWorld.

items.title: Codex 0.171.0：加入 GPT-6.2 Sol 和 Astra，默认开启 TUI 工作区
items.summary: OpenAI Codex 0.171.0 把 GPT-6.2 Sol 和 Astra 加入模型目录，并把 Sol 设为默认选择；TUI 工作区默认开启，可在主对话旁查看文档预览、图片预览和 subagent 记录。新版还加入 codex exec --remote，可在已有 app server 上启动或恢复非交互会话，并新增 /rc 和 /remote 管理远程控制。

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.329：/tasks 可管理定时任务和 fork
items.summary: 新版在信任对话框中提示文件夹的 hooks 在哪里声明，/tasks 加入本会话的定时任务、/loop 唤醒和 fork，并修复 ~/.claude.json 偶尔被重置为默认值的问题。
